verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents prompt-to-video: an AI Assistant turns a prompt, link, or file into a polished video, and you can 'write a prompt and add context. Get a finished video.' Iterating on that result without starting over is only implied by generic editing and review workflows, and by 'fully editable' output in the separate PPT-to-video flow. Missing for 10: documentation of re-prompting or refining a generated video in place, explicit editability of prompt-generated output, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the prompt-to-video workflow.
